view-01.png.evidence: Strong aircraft shape and color exist outside the central deck cluster.
view-01.png.regressions: Opaque-looking disks, square wake and objective text cover the deck and aircraft.

view-02.png.evidence: Wing markings remain distinct; quiet smoke allows the deck to read.
view-02.png.regressions: Sea flecks compete with impacts and the nose overlap hides the player shape.

view-03.png.evidence: Crisp flight deck and raised island sit above fine continuous navy ripples. The wake tapers away from the hull.
view-03.png.regressions: Player still sits over an edge of the bow; water looks repetitively mottled.

view-04.png.evidence: Tree shadows are more compact under the shoreline trees. Individual crowns and trunks separate better from the grass, especially the lower clusters. The coast, player ring and HUD retain their prior contrast.
view-04.png.regressions: The improvement is local to foliage. The prominent cyan player ring still competes with the scene. Sparse open grass still looks repetitive.

view-05.png.evidence: Field stripes and aircraft silhouette are sharp, with small sea streaks.
view-05.png.regressions: Text overlaps aircraft, faceted trees sit on patchy green land, and shoreline is a uniform stripe.

view-07.png.regressions: Nose overlap and softened fighter silhouettes.

view-08.png.regressions: Soft overlapping planes, label, flat discs and square wake swamp the carrier's readability.
